summary: Iter 58 (one consistent left/right swipe animation across all tab surfaces + removal of the black swipe toast and the manual prev/next chevrons on the category screen) fully validated on the 390x844 web preview via CDP touch events. Every swipe surface behaves per spec: bottom tabs, /orders filters, /shop-category, /vendor/dashboard, /vendor/orders and /vendor/invoices all step exactly one position per flick, both boundaries hold with no wrap-around, tab-swipe is correctly DISABLED on drilled-in routes (/wallet, /network, /shop-category/<name>) and Shop-home correctly RELEASES the horizontal drag to the parent tab pager. UI-side: the black swipe toast and the cat-prev / cat-next chevron buttons are gone; the 'SWIPE ↔ CATEGORY' eyebrow still renders; the /orders chip strip is a compact 30px row (no giant pills); multi-vendor split cards, group header, 'Ask this seller', invoice modal, cash summary card all confirmed working (regression sweep pass). Zero blocking issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: shop-home.tsx has two duplicate style keys (`sectionTitle` — no, actually `hList`) declared twice inside the StyleSheet.create block (lines 1261 and 1266); RN-Web silently uses the second definition. Pre-existing per gotchas, not introduced by iter 58, but worth de-duping in a future cleanup.

Frontend .env exposes the backend URL as EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, not the EXPO_BACKEND_URL name mentioned in the system prompt. Only relevant for tooling; the app itself reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly.
